2120329055182701035.en_summary: Marc Cohodes lists questions for Kyle Kazan of Glass House Brands ($GLAS) on daily duties, firing of Jon DeCourcey, yearly related party payments controlled by him, the Rosenwalds or Beach Front, costs of the cogeneration issue and lack of insurance coverage, and why Director Nichols resigned without an 8-K. Quoted post notes $GLAS earnings call on Nov 16 after market close.
2120329055182701035.zh_summary: Marc Cohodes列出對Glass House Brands ($GLAS)的Kyle Kazan提出的問題，包括日常職責、解雇Jon DeCourcey、每年向其本人、Rosenwalds或Beach Front控制的相關方支付的款項、熱電聯產問題的成本及保險未覆蓋原因，以及董事Nichols辭職但未提交8-K的原因。引用帖文指出$GLAS將於11月16日盤後舉行財報電話會議。
